# Step 1 数据理解与清洗
## 读取数据
```{r}
library(readr)

care <- read_csv("./data/care_state.csv")
```
## 检查数据 1
```{r}
head(care)
```

## 检查数据 2
```{r}
library(dplyr)

glimpse(care)
```

## 检查数据缺失值
```{r}
colSums(is.na(care))
```
## 剔除数据缺失值
```{r}
care_clean <- care %>%
  filter(!is.na(score))
colSums(is.na(care_clean))
```

# Step 2 单变量分析
## 对score做可视化（无分组）
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
ggplot(care_clean, aes(x = score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue")
```

## 对score做可视化（按照医疗场景进行分组）
```{r}
ggplot(care_clean, aes(x = score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~condition, scales = "free")
```
